name: LG Billet USA
about:
LG Billet USA operates from Chandler, Arizona, where it designs and machines billet aluminum accessories for Chevrolet and GMC trucks. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders.

The product line focuses on interior and exterior trim pieces—shift levers, door handles, hood releases, grab handles, climate knobs, and battery mounts—for Chevy/GMC C/K trucks from 1960 through 1998, Silverado/Sierra models from 1999 to 2013, S10 pickups (1982–2004), and Camaros (1967–1992). Parts are CNC-machined from 6061 aluminum, then assembled and packaged in-house. Finishes include a raw machined look, black anodizing, and black powder coating. The catalog lists dozens of distinct part numbers, each offered in multiple finish options.

LG Billet USA sells directly to retail customers through its e-commerce site, which offers free shipping on orders over $150 and international delivery. A “Become A Dealer” link indicates a wholesale channel for resellers. The primary customer base consists of classic-truck enthusiasts, restoration shops, and owners seeking OEM-quality upgrades for daily drivers or show vehicles.

The company states that its parts are “proudly made in the USA, crafted with high-quality materials and precision engineering,” positioning domestic manufacturing and material quality as its core differentiators.
